Khushi ek maksad hona hai.
Khushi raasta hai.
Apni khushi khud dhoondho.
Joy bike par baalon mein hawa hona hai.
Khushi aam hai.
Azadi durlabh hai.
Khushi rooh ka sukoon hai.
Khushi ek attitude hai. Hum khud ko dukh ya khush aur majboot banate hain.
Happiness do palms ke beech ek hammock hai.
Joy achanak badhne ki bhavna hai.
Jahan apne vichar kehne ki azaadi na ho, wahan azaadi bematlab hai.
Azadi jagah hai.
Khushi intensity ki nahi balki balance, order, rhythm aur meaning ki baat hai.
Khushi ek mansik sthiti hai.
Khushi roshni hai.
Azaadi khul kar chunne ka adhikar hai.
Azaadi hamari insaniyat ka kendra hai.
Azaadi ka matlab vyakti kisi manmaane shasan ke adheen nahi hai.
Azaadi vichar ki mukti hai.
Adventure joy ka ultimate form hai.
Khushi ek nayi chetna ki subah hai.
Khushi vikas hai.
Ek aazad insaan woh hai jiske paas taqat aur dimaag hai, aur jo boundaries todne se nahi darta.
Azaadi zulm ke khilaf sabse bada hathiyar hai.
Khushi safar ka tareeqa hai, manzil nahi.
Khushi badhne ka ehsaas hai.
